title: Honey Garlic Chicken with Broccoli
description: A fast weeknight skillet with a sticky honey-garlic glaze
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and season with black pepper
Sear chicken in a hot skillet until golden and cooked through, then remove
Steam or blanch broccoli until bright green and tender-crisp
Whisk together honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, and ginger
Return chicken to the skillet with the broccoli, pour in the sauce, and toss until glazed

title: Sheet-Pan Honey Garlic Salmon
description: Oven-roasted salmon glazed with honey, garlic, and ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with foil
Whisk honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, and ginger together
Place salmon skin-side down on the pan and brush generously with the glaze
Roast until the salmon flakes easily, about 12-15 minutes
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top before serving

title: Weeknight Egg Fried Rice
description: A quick fried rice built around scrambled eggs and pantry vegetables
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions and let cool (day-old rice works best)
Dice the carrot and onion
Scramble the eggs in a hot wok or large skillet, then remove and set aside
Sauté carrot and onion until softened
Add the cooled rice, breaking up clumps, then stir in soy sauce, ginger, and black pepper
Fold the scrambled eggs back in and toss until evenly combined

title: Family-Style Shrimp Tacos
description: Seared shrimp tacos with avocado, red onion, and lime
instructions: Season shrimp with black pepper
Sear in a hot skillet for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and opaque
Warm the corn tortillas
Slice the avocado and finely dice the red onion
Assemble tacos with shrimp, avocado, red onion, and cilantro
Finish with a generous squeeze of lime

title: Greek Yogurt Tandoori Chicken
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken with curry spices, grilled or roasted
instructions: Whisk together greek yogurt, curry powder, minced garlic, ginger, and lemon juice
Add chicken and coat thoroughly, then marinate for at least 30 minutes
Grill or bake at 425°F until cooked through and lightly charred, about 20-25 minutes
Let rest for a few minutes before slicing

title: Sweet Potato & Beef Skillet
description: A one-pan comfort dinner of ground beef and caramelized sweet potato
instructions: Dice the sweet potatoes into small cubes
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and cook the sweet potato until tender, about 8-10 minutes
Push to one side, add the ground beef and diced onion, and cook until browned
Stir in minced garlic and black pepper
Combine everything in the skillet and cook for another 2-3 minutes

title: Crispy Peanut Tofu with Quinoa
description: Pan-fried tofu in a peanut-garlic sauce over quinoa
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions
Press and cube the tofu, then pan-fry in a hot skillet until golden and crisp
Whisk together peanut butter, soy sauce, minced garlic, and ginger with a splash of water
Shred the carrot
Toss the crispy tofu in the peanut sauce and serve over quinoa topped with shredded carrot

title: Spanish-Style Potato & Egg Skillet
description: A rustic skillet of tender potatoes and eggs, tortilla española-style
instructions: Thinly slice the potatoes and onion
Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet and cook the potatoes and onion over low heat until tender, about 15 minutes
Whisk the eggs with black pepper
Pour the eggs over the potatoes and onion
Cook over low heat until mostly set, then finish under a broiler until fully cooked
Slice into wedges to serve

title: Pan-Seared Crab Cakes
description: Golden, pan-fried crab cakes with lemon and garlic
instructions: Combine crab meat, beaten egg, flour, minced garlic, black pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice
Form into patties
Pan-sear in a hot, lightly oiled skillet for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown
Serve with extra lemon wedges
